notes.title: Animations Update
notes.content:
Overview

This is an update that includes new models for the Hero and Jacob, and new animations for a brand new room, and the Hero! This is in addition to a ton of bug fixes, QOL reworks and laying the foundation for more complex rooms, and tower generation.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45344747/1a6b2d9d99d1b1fe4852871eca66703e0475f110.png"]
What's New○ The Hero has a brand new look○ Jacob the Heroes Hero also has a softer more ethereal look○ The Hero can walk now! Instead of sliding across the floor they now have a fully animated walk and idle animation!○ 300% more interact dialogue in the game (Pressing Space over a background object to learn more)○ Hero now flashes red or green, when they take damage, or heal○ Added RoomOfSacrifice. Interacting with the VultureTotem in this room offers great risk, but also great reward... \[It appears on floors 5 and up]○ Sneaking in some threads of story

Fixes And QOL
Fixed Arctic Assault

Fixed projectile particles being In front of the projectile

Fixed dungeon ambient track not looping after the combat track plays

Spikes break upon hitting the player

Store Page Update Coming Soon...

notes.title: Bait inflation Increased
notes.content:
Sorry everyone. Upon buffing fish we have need to inflate bait prices once again. Everyone wants these brand new fish! (inflation occurs at max floors 12 and 24 specifically).

Other Fixes


Seals no longer phase through walls
Enhanced Strikes works correctly (It was two scripts before, now it is one script that works)

notes.title: Fishing Buff
notes.content:
Increased Fishing quality threshold from


 3 to 2 for health (Meaning 6 quality gives 3 health)
 7 to 6 for magic and Attack (Meaning 6 quality gives 2 of those stats respectively)

notes.title: The Legendary Fish
notes.content:
Ways To Win

During This Event There Are Two Ways To Win
[olist]
Be The First To Catch The Legendary Fish
Before The Challenge Time Expires Catch The Fish With The Highest Quality
[/olist]

The Legendary Prismatic Fish

   There is a Fish known only in name as The Prismatic Fish. This legendary fish is hard to come by but offers a great slew of skills to go forth into the dungeon with. Can you be the fist to catch it?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45344747/41568108522297d82b7b1830825bc5e45448b611.png

Quality Fisher
   The Max Fishing quality is determined by how far in the dungeon you have gone (Including New Game +) so if The Legendary Fish has already been caught, or if you want to hedge your bets, then this is the challenge for you. Simply catch the best quality fish!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45344747/0ef103e90027aa0dedf02c07bf7d6284f644f6c3.png


How To Submit My Fish
Where To Post
   Steam has a built in feature called "Screenshots" (as seen in the community tab).
How To Screenshot
   Steam by default uses f12 to take a screenshot for any game. Take one of those screenshots and share it to the community page with title The Legendary Fish Challenge so I can find it once the time is up.
When Will I Receive The Soundtrack Key
   I will send you a steam message with the key attached when I get a key to send after the challenge.




Good Luck

notes.title: Collider Patch
notes.content:
No longer can coins, or monsters, be outside of the colliders!

I didn't touch them before as they were hard coded and I was new to Unity, but after changing some script they are now dynamically (And correctly) at the start of the first room and at the edge of the stairwell!

Thanks for all the support so far, so now go forth and enjoy more room in the Tower!

(Oh also we now have zero AI art)

notes.title: Projectile Changes
notes.content:
I have nerfed almost all of the projectiles so they now have a wider and taller hitbox.


 This should allow for a greater success rate in terms of parrying.
 This also makes the Wizards Eye less lethal, as before you couldn't parry when the projectile was above you, but you still took damage. Now you can parry in from any height or depth.
 Wizards Eye Projectile speed buffed (was 10 now is 15)
 Sealsorer Projectile speed buffed (Was 25 now is 30)
 All projectiles now have trails, and will properly make noise

notes.title: Day 2 Hot Fixes
notes.content:
Rewrapped the correct shop text this time
 Fixed Enhanced Strikes not requiring mana

notes.title: Day 1 Patches pt 2
notes.content:
While Blue Was Playtesting He Found The Following Errors



 Arctic Assault was ineffective against the Cold Rat Boss (Floor 10)
 Shop had overflowing text at higher levels
 Magma Slime Chamber had a gatling gun of fireballs near the exit (The delay was set to 0 XD)

All Of Which Have Been Fixed

notes.title: I Noticed The Escape Morb Text Was Hard/Impossible To See
notes.content:
So I changed the text color to white which then let me notice other things...


 HP Now Displayed As Hp/MaxHp
 Parry Window Is Bigger For Projectiles
 Combat Text Moved To The Left (Instead Of Above) The Button
 I Tripled The Fire Rate Of The Sorcerers Eye
 Escape Morb Text On Left (To Prevent Overlap)
 Inventory Now Has Dynamic Size Changes
 Combat Text No Longer Has Margins (I Have No Idea How This One Even Happened To Begin With XD)
 Deleted Some Unused Assets

notes.title: The Major Update Is Here!
notes.content:
Completely Reworked Graphics


Dungeons
Backgrounds
New Assets
More Music
More Sound Effects

For the goal of removing AI Art. Let's just say the purge was successful in that regard.
Content

     I'm not going to leave you with only a complete graphical overhaul however. That would be too easy! So I added a fishing zone, new dungeon rooms, and even a menu (So you don't have to alt-f4 Whenever You Want To Leave). With a sub menu for cheats! This in addition to doing so many bug fixes I can't even recall!!!

Hope you enjoy and have a great day and or night!

notes.title: Huge Update Incoming
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45344747/46b8a1113c618f030cbe73eb5ed5939188e9f161.png
Hello everyone, Rpg Penguin here.
     Here to announce that there's been a lot going on these past months that pertain to the future of Tower Of Penguinaria! So far we have made huge strides in removing all of the AI art placeholders. But just changing the graphics isn't enough for us at Penguins Incorporated (Our unofficial company name), so I have been hard at work, working on more content for you all to enjoy and replacing all the old background and dungeon art! As Blue has been setting up the assets for a brand new location where one may partake in everyone's favorite roguelike pastime... Gambling! 

Addressing Responses
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45344747/e2037d8591f9b509b7d704ebe42a030009d9df8a.png
   To my surprise there has been a lot of in depth reviews coming in for The Tower Of Penguinaria So here are a few I want to talk about.

   To start reviewer Coke_Can pointed out something crucial that I have been focusing my efforts on when it comes to dungeon design. Coke_Can said, "Adding a transition in the background pixel art between each area, it felt like I was walking through walls and it is really unclear where the edge of each floor is." And to that I have designed the dungeon with that clarity in mind. While it is no transition I have kept a consistent room background in this next update so that the rooms have that sense of flow that was so sorely missing before.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45344747/7f67fa9453984bc2f0257a4b702af07818dd31ea.png

   Next, a trend that is consistent through reviews "A very fun and addicting Rougelike that is a little confusing at first but you'll quickly catch on and have a great time..." (CaiusNotPlaying). It's clear to me that we need to make the tutorial clearer and get people past that initial hunch of learning a new game. It is my hope that these new assets and a slightly better tutorial will help more people enjoy the game.

   As for the discord server people have been posting tons of really cool ideas, and I have made efforts to implement them. Especially ones that streamline gameplay and avoid unwanted interactions. One issue that was caught in the discord by PaisleyElf, was that the projectile deflection and escape morb buttons were the same. In this way when the eye trap fired if you were in a room with the morb you would accidently leave. This has also been amended in this upcoming update.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45344747/2d49d27c98b3e35322063f3bc2ae83b40884c482.png
New Content
   The primary thing here is a new dungeon room known as the plentiful grove. This room has 2 states; Plentiful and Barren. If you ever find yourself low on hp or mana, and happen to find this grove you can replenish all expended mana and hp! It's always nice to have a resting room in roguelikes so why not add one here?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45344747/33b1f0c97356ca62872a36c7a5704f6500970450.png
   There is also a new song that plays when you head to a specific location in the overworld...
   Oh I also added a menu.

Anynoot here are some sneak peak images on the new update, let me know what you think, and have a great day and or night!

 Wizard Hat overlaps inventory menu
 Jacob (The ghost that you see on the far right side of the skill point allocation area (Kenos)) Had some unclear tips which have been reworked
